scheme_name: AICTE – Mitacs Globalink Research Internship (GRI) Scheme
other_conditions: Must be a 3rd‑year full‑time student of an undergraduate B.E/B.Tech program in an AICTE‑approved institution
Must have a minimum CGPA/GPA of 85 % in the 2nd year
Must be able to spend twelve weeks between May and September at a university in Canada on a research project related to the applicant’s area of interest and expertise
Must demonstrate oral and written fluency in English or French, as required by the Canadian host professor
Must apply directly through the MITACS Canada portal
Must have a valid passport and obtain all necessary documents and permissions, including a visa and air tickets, before traveling
benefits_summary: The scheme provides a total funding of $12,000 CAD per student (₹9,000 CAD from MITACS and $3,000 CAD from AICTE) covering airfare, visa, medical, stipend, accommodation, mentorship and related activities.
documents_required: Notarized transcripts (if application materials are not in English or French)
